newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LECHKOV, CASCARINO SET TO LEAVE MARSEILLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LECHKOV, CASCARINO SET TO LEAVE MARSEILLE.

text.p: Bulgarian midfielder Iordan Lechkov and Irish striker Tony Cascarino could soon be leaving French first division side Marseille.
Sources at the club said on Thursday that Turkish champions Fenerbahce had made an offer for 29-year-old Lechkov, who joined the former European champions this season from German club Hamburg.
They also said officials from Marseille would hold talks with counterparts from French club Caen this weekend in a bid to secure a transfer deal for 34-year-old Cascarino.
Neither player has secured a first team place at Marseille this season.
